name: frontier-cs/symbolic_regression
description: Symbolic regression: discover a closed-form expression f(x1..xn) that fits each target function with low error and low complexity. Scored across 5 target families (mccormick, mixed_polyexp_4d, peaks, ripple, sincos); the reported score is the mean of the per-target scores, each 100*clamp((m_base-MSE)/(m_base-m_ref),0,1) with a 0.99^max(complexity-C_ref,0) simplicity penalty. Edit solution.py: a Solution class whose solve(X, y) returns {expression, details}.
setupCommand: set -e; command -v pip3 >/dev/null 2>&1 || (apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq python3-pip); python3 -m pip install --quiet --break-system-packages 'numpy>=1.24' 'pandas>=2.0' 'sympy>=1.12'
